attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL10) as systemd-managed services, opened firewalld ports 2379/2380, verified cross-member read/write replication, demonstrated write/read availability while node3 was stopped plus its subsequent catch-up, then sequentially rebooted all three nodes one at a time (preserving quorum throughout) and confirmed each node's boot identity changed and the cluster/data fully recovered after each restart.
